subject.title: feat(ios): redesign Control tab to a flatter, card-based layout

question: Should this older card-based iOS Control tab redesign continue after current main landed the native List-based Control hub and broader native iOS direction?
rationale: The branch is a visual product direction change, current main now asserts different Control hub contracts, and automation cannot choose whether the older card layout should override or be retargeted to the native direction.

options.title: Retarget to current native hub
options.body: Ask the contributor to rebase and express only the accepted parts of the card idea on top of the current native List/Gateway-detail implementation with visual proof.

options.title: Accept card direction
options.body: A maintainer can intentionally choose the card-based Control layout, but should require conflict resolution, OpenClawType cleanup, and simulator proof first.

options.title: Close as superseded
options.body: If the native iOS direction is now the chosen baseline, close this PR and leave any remaining design exploration to the linked issue or RFC path.

recommendation.title: Retarget to current native hub
recommendation.body: Ask the contributor to rebase and express only the accepted parts of the card idea on top of the current native List/Gateway-detail implementation with visual proof.

likelyOwner.reason: They landed the overlapping native iOS visual direction and current-main Control/Talk changes most relevant to this decision.
